help.description: Contact WallX, give our support team temporary access, and find quick guides.
help.noContacts: Support contacts will appear here soon.
help.orgId: Your organization ID (mention it when you contact us):

pair.title: Add a screen
pair.body: Install the WallX Play Player on the Android box and open it. It shows a pairing code: add the screen here with that code (or scan the QR code with your phone).

content.title: Upload content
content.body: Upload images and videos to the Content Library. Videos are converted automatically so every box can play them.

publish.title: Build and publish
publish.body: Combine media, layouts and widgets in a playlist, then publish. Screens keep playing their last published content while offline.

schedule.title: Schedule by time and place
schedule.body: Schedules decide which playlist plays on which screens, on which days and hours. Higher priority wins when schedules overlap.

emergency.title: Emergency messages
emergency.body: Show an urgent message on chosen screens immediately, above everything else, until you end it or it times out.

sensors.title: Sensors on screen
sensors.body: Connect ESP32 sensors, add channels (e.g. temperature), and show live values on screens with sensor widgets or table cells.

team.title: Team and permissions
team.body: Invite people with a built-in or custom role, and limit them to some sites when needed.

billing.title: Subscription
billing.body: See your plan, usage and payments, and ask WallX to add screens or change the plan.

supportAccess.title: WallX support access
supportAccess.explain: WallX support staff can see your organization only while you allow it, for the time you choose. They never see passwords or API keys, and cannot change your team, billing or settings. Everything they do is in your activity log.
supportAccess.giveHint: You can end it at any time. It also ends by itself when the time is up.
supportAccess.none: WallX support has no access to your organization.

levelHints.view: Support can look at screens, content and settings to find a problem, but not change anything.
levelHints.edit: Support can also fix content, publish and restart screens. Not your team, billing or settings.

supportAccess.session: You are in {{org}} with WallX support access until {{until}}. The customer can see this and end it.

adminSupport.description: Customer organizations are visible to WallX staff only through time-limited access the customer can see and end.
adminSupport.reasonHint: Shown to the customer, e.g. “Screen 3 in Pune shows a black screen”.
adminSupport.emergency: Emergency: give access now without waiting for the customer
adminSupport.emergencyHint: Only when the customer cannot respond and something is seriously wrong. The customer is notified and it is recorded in their activity log.
adminSupport.policy: Owners and admins answer requests under Help & Support. Access ends on time automatically; support staff never see passwords or API keys.

adminResellers.description: Partners who sell WallX Play: their dealer prices and wholesale payments, their team, and the organizations they manage through the partner portal.
adminResellers.name: Name
adminResellers.reasonHint: Recorded in the audit log for each change, e.g. “Signed through partner”.
adminResellers.inactiveHint: This reseller is inactive, so no organizations can be added.
adminResellers.portalLabel: The reseller’s team can use the partner portal
adminResellers.howItWorks: Resellers buy screens at their dealer price and bill their customers themselves. Invite the reseller’s owner under “Billing & team”; record their payments there, and their paid customers follow their paid period.
adminResellers.discountHint: Off each plan’s list price per screen per month (0–90).
adminResellers.fixedPrice: {{plan}}: fixed dealer price (₹ per screen per month)
adminResellers.fixedPriceHint: List {{list}}; with the discount {{auto}}. Leave empty to use the discount.
adminResellers.noListPrice: This plan has no list price: set the dealer price here.
adminResellers.priceError: Enter an amount in rupees, e.g. 450 or 450.50.
adminResellers.paidThroughHint: The reseller’s paid customers take this date. Leave empty to clear it.
adminResellers.reasonHint5: At least 5 characters; recorded in the audit log.
adminResellers.amountHint: Amount received in rupees, including GST.
adminResellers.paymentHelp: The paid period is extended from its current end (if it has not lapsed) and copied to every customer the reseller pays for.
adminResellers.voidBody: Mark the payment of {{amount}} as void (e.g. a bounced cheque). Correct the paid-through date separately.
adminResellers.wholesaleLabel: The reseller pays for this organization (wholesale)
adminResellers.whiteLabelLabel: White label: the reseller can brand the app for its customers

adminSettings.description: Settings that apply to all of WallX Play.
adminSettings.readOnly: Only superadmins can change platform settings.
adminSettings.supportHint: Shown to every customer on the Help & Support page. Leave a field empty to hide it.
adminSettings.bannerOn: Show a notice at the top of every page
adminSettings.bannerHint: For example planned maintenance. People can dismiss it; a new message shows again.
adminSettings.bannerUntilHint: Optional. Leave empty to show it until you turn it off.
adminSettings.signupsHint: When off, people can still create an account and join existing organizations by invitation, but cannot request a new organization.
adminSettings.playerSigner: Releases must be signed with the key whose SHA-256 is {{sha}}.
adminSettings.playerSignerNone: No player release uploaded yet. The first release sets the signing key all later releases must use.

adminPlayers.description: Upload new versions of the Android player and choose which screens get them.
adminPlayers.apkHint: The signed release build (./gradlew assembleRelease) with a higher versionCode than the last release.
adminPlayers.tooLarge: That file is too large for a player APK.
adminPlayers.checkedHint: It is a draft: no screen gets it until you change its rollout.

rolloutHints.pilot: Only screens of the organizations below get it. Try a new version with a few friendly customers first.
rolloutHints.all: Every screen gets it within a few minutes (screens on Android older than the APK’s minimum are skipped).
rolloutHints.withdrawn: No screen gets it any more. Screens that already installed it keep it until a newer version is rolled out.

adminPlayers.waiting_one: {{count}} screen has downloaded an update and needs someone to select Install. Press a remote key at the screen, or use “Install player update” in Screens & Players.
adminPlayers.waiting_other: {{count}} screens have downloaded an update and need someone to select Install. Press a remote key at the screen, or use “Install player update” in Screens & Players.
adminPlayers.failing_one: {{count}} screen reported a failed update. See its errors in Screens & Players; it tries again after 6 hours.
adminPlayers.failing_other: {{count}} screens reported a failed update. See their errors in Screens & Players; they try again after 6 hours.
adminPlayers.howItWorks: Players check for a newer version every minute and download it in the background while playing. Boxes set up as a kiosk (device owner) and Android 12+ boxes install by themselves; others need someone at the screen to select Install once.

adminDevices.description: Every screen and player across all organizations: status, app version and health.
adminDevices.search: Search screen, organization or box model
adminDevices.recentErrors: Recent errors reported by the player

updateStates.waiting_user: v{{version}} downloaded; someone at the screen must select Install

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Network problem. Check your connection and try again.
errors.emulatorsDown: Development mode: the local Firebase emulators are not running. Start them with “npm run emulators”, then try again.
errors.permissionDenied: You do not have permission for this action.

auth.emailInUse: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
auth.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.popupClosed: The sign-in window was closed before finishing.
auth.invalidCode: That code is not right. Enter the current code from your authenticator app.
auth.mfaSessionExpired: Sign-in took too long. Go back and sign in again.
auth.notEnabled: This option is not turned on for WallX Play yet. Contact WallX support.
auth.tooManyFactors: This account already has the most authenticator apps allowed. Remove one first.

placeholder.title: Coming in phase {{phase}}
placeholder.description: This area is part of the WallX Play roadmap and will be built in phase {{phase}}.
placeholder.releaseDescription: This area is planned for the {{release}} release of WallX Play, after the first version.

player.title: Player registration
player.description: WallX Play screens run the dedicated Android player app on the Android box connected to your LED controller.
player.step1: Install the WallX Play Player app on the Android box.
player.step2: Open the app. It shows a pairing code and QR code on the screen.
player.step3: Sign in to WallX Play, open Screens and choose Add screen, then enter the code.
player.step4: An organization admin authorizes the screen before content is delivered.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

notAuthorized.title: No access
notAuthorized.description: This area is only for WallX platform administrators.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.description: After verifying your email you can request an organization. WallX reviews every new organization before it goes live.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your email and we will send you a reset link.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this email, a reset link is on its way.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.description: We sent a verification link to {{email}}. Open it, then come back here.
verify.notYet: Your email is not verified yet. Check your inbox and spam folder.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.description: After your password, sign-in asks for a 6-digit code from an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator and similar).
mfa.none: Two-step verification is off for this account.
mfa.removeLastStaff: Without an authenticator app you cannot use Super Admin until you set up a new one.
mfa.enrolled: Two-step verification is on. Sign-in will ask for a code from your authenticator app.
mfa.staffRequired: Set up an authenticator app to use Super Admin and other WallX tools.
mfa.signInAgain: Sign out and sign in again with a code from your authenticator app to continue.
mfa.recentLogin: For your security, sign in again before changing two-step verification.
mfa.emulator: Development mode: the Firebase Auth emulator cannot use authenticator apps, so staff do not need two-step verification here.

setup.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
setup.enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
setup.qrAlt: QR code to add WallX Play to an authenticator app
setup.manual: Cannot scan? Enter this key in the app:
setup.name: Name (optional)
setup.nameHint: Helps you tell apps apart, for example “Work phone”.

signIn.title: Enter your verification code
signIn.description: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for WallX Play.
signIn.unsupported: This account uses a kind of two-step verification this app does not support. Contact WallX support.

onboarding.pausedBody: WallX Play is not accepting new organizations at the moment. Please contact WallX support, or try again later.
onboarding.title: Set up your organization
onboarding.description: Tell us about your business. A WallX administrator reviews each request, usually within one business day.
onboarding.gstinHint: Optional now; needed for GST invoices.
onboarding.notesHint: For example: locations, LED wall sizes or integrations you need.
onboarding.responseRequired: Add a short reply for the reviewer.
onboarding.pendingBody: Your request for {{org}} is waiting for WallX approval. You will be able to add screens and publish content once it is approved.
onboarding.approvedNoAccess: This organization is approved but not currently active. Contact WallX support if this is unexpected.
onboarding.hasActiveOrg: You already belong to an active organization.
onboarding.inviteHint: Joining an existing organization? Open the invitation link your administrator sent you.

invite.title: Join organization
invite.description: You are signed in as {{email}}. Accept the invitation to join the organization.

roles.ownerHint: Full control, including billing and other owners.
roles.adminHint: Manages team, screens, content and settings. Cannot change billing.
roles.approverHint: Creates content and approves others’ content before publishing.
roles.viewerHint: Read-only access to screens, content and reports.

customRoles.title: Custom roles
customRoles.empty: No custom roles yet. Create one when the built-in roles don’t fit, for example a store manager who can only restart screens and publish.
customRoles.name: Role name
customRoles.startFromHint: Copies a built-in role’s permissions; adjust them below.
customRoles.memberManageNote: can give anyone, including themselves, any role except Owner
customRoles.billingNote: Changing the plan or billing stays with owners.
customRoles.appliesNow_one: {{count}} member has this role; changes apply to them immediately.
customRoles.appliesNow_other: {{count}} members have this role; changes apply to them immediately.
customRoles.deleteBody: {{name}} will be deleted. Give its members another role first.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.allGood: All screens are online and up to date.
dashboard.noScreensYet: No screens yet — pair your first screen to start.

issues.screenLimit: Screen limit reached ({{limit}}) — upgrade to add more screens

team.someSitesHint: Sees and manages only these sites’ screens, sensors and alerts. Organization-wide settings (team, billing, integrations) are not available.
team.supportMember: WallX support, until {{until}} (managed under Help & Support)
team.inviteLinkHint: Send this link to the person you invited. It works once, only for their email address, and expires in 7 days.
team.inviteEmailed: We also emailed the invitation to {{email}}. You can share the link yourself as well.
team.removeBody: {{email}} will lose access to this organization immediately.
team.emailNote: Invitation emails are sent automatically once the notification service is enabled; until then, share the link yourself.
team.partnerAccessOn: Your reseller’s team can manage your screens and content. Changes they make appear in your audit log.
team.partnerAccessOff: You switched your reseller’s access off. They can no longer open this organization.

sites.title: Sites & Groups
sites.description: Locations where your screens are installed.
sites.name: Site name
sites.emptyBody: Add a site for each location, such as a store, lobby or factory floor. Screens and sensors are assigned to sites.
sites.deleteBody: {{name}} will be deleted. Sites with screens cannot be deleted.

settings.readOnly: Only owners and admins can change these settings.
settings.timezoneHint: Used for new sites and schedules.
settings.requireApprovalHint: Editors’ publishes become requests that an Approver, Admin or Owner must approve.
settings.requireApprovalNotInPlan: Publish approvals are part of the Professional plan.
settings.emailNotificationsHint: Screen offline, emergencies, publish requests, sensor alerts, billing and support access are emailed to the members who handle them.

overview.description: Platform health and work waiting for you.
overview.comingBody: Screen health, storage usage and billing issues appear here as those modules are built.

approvals.description: Every new organization must be approved before it can pair screens or publish content.

confirmBody.approve: {{org}} becomes active with a 14-day free trial. Its users can then add sites, team members and screens.
confirmBody.reject: {{org}} will not be able to use WallX Play. The requester sees your reason.
confirmBody.request_info: {{org}} stays inactive until the requester answers. They see your message.

approvals.messageHint: Visible to the requester and recorded in the audit log.

orgs.name: Organization
orgs.suspendBody: Users lose the ability to make changes and publish. This is recorded in the audit log.
orgs.reasonHint: At least 5 characters. Recorded in the audit log.

users.description: WallX staff and their platform roles.
users.emailHint: The person must already have a WallX Play account.
users.saved: Role updated for {{email}}. They must sign in again for it to apply.
users.superadminOnly: Only superadmins can manage platform roles.

audit.description: Append-only record of sensitive actions. Entries are hash-chained per organization.
audit.notAllowed: Only superadmins and auditors can view audit logs.
